# part order

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:partOrder`](gmeow-partOrder.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/partOrder>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/names`](../../slices/names.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The 0-based position of a part within its appellation's surface order, as actually written in its culture. Records observed order WITHOUT implying a given-before-family default — East-Asian family-first is simply order 0 = surname.

## Structure

**Property shape:** datatype property; [`gmeow:NamePart`](../classes/gmeow-NamePart.md) -> [`xsd:nonNegativeInteger`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#nonNegativeInteger); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:partOrder`](gmeow-partOrder.md) from [`gmeow:NamePart`](../classes/gmeow-NamePart.md) to [`xsd:nonNegativeInteger`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#nonNegativeInteger) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to record the 0-based written position of a [`gmeow:NamePart`](../classes/gmeow-NamePart.md) within its appellation's surface order, as actually written in its culture.

### Avoid when

- Avoid reading a given-before-family default into the ordering (East-Asian family-first is simply order 0 = surname) and avoid using it to drive display reassembly — [`gmeow:fullName`](gmeow-fullName.md) is authoritative for the surface form.

### How to use

- Set [`gmeow:partOrder`](gmeow-partOrder.md) once per [`gmeow:NamePart`](../classes/gmeow-NamePart.md) (functional) to the part's 0-based position in the culture's actual order; never renumber to impose a Western order.

### Examples

- ex:yamadaSurname [`gmeow:partOrder`](gmeow-partOrder.md) 0.
